key.name: panel-position
key.description: Which area of the top bar the indicator is placed in: left, center, or right.

key.name: detail-size
key.description: Scale of the dropdown detail panel: original, medium (1.25x), or large (1.5x).

key.name: color-mode
key.description: Whether the detail panel uses light, dark, or system-matching colors. Auto follows the system color-scheme preference.

key.name: detail-panel-position
key.description: Where the detail panel appears after clicking the panel pill: default (drops down from the pill), or pinned to a screen location — top-left, top-center, top-right, middle-left, middle-center, middle-right, bottom-left, bottom-center, or bottom-right.

key.name: panel-show-icon
key.summary: Show the metric icon in the panel
key.description: Whether the icon for the selected metric is shown alongside its value in the top bar.

key.name: refresh-interval
key.description: How often (in seconds) the power metrics are polled. Allowed values: 5, 10, 15, 20, 25, 30.

key.name: boot-id
key.summary: Boot identifier of the last accumulation
key.description: Stores the kernel boot_id used to detect reboots. When it changes, the rolling averages are reset.

key.name: brightness-manage
key.description: When enabled, the extension sets screen brightness based on the current power source.

key.name: brightness-on-battery
key.description: Screen brightness percentage applied when running on battery power.

key.name: brightness-on-ac
key.description: Screen brightness percentage applied when plugged in to AC power.

key.name: power-profile-manage
key.description: When enabled, the extension sets the power-profiles-daemon profile based on the current power source.

key.name: power-profile-on-battery
key.description: power-profiles-daemon profile applied when running on battery power.

key.name: power-profile-on-ac
key.description: power-profiles-daemon profile applied when plugged in to AC power.
